in each thread shown the reader is given the three first-pass notes, the round-one replies on that thread, and who asked to see its statements and why
the reader is given the statements of the eleven threads that any reader asked to see, laid out and numbered as in the first pass; every reader is given all eleven, whoever asked
the reader is given every reader's round-one replies to the whole board, and every closing
the reader's own notebook and its own model's round-one messages are marked as its own, with the reason: the same model wrote them
the reader is not told which model family wrote which notebook; signatures are shown as written, and the third notebook's signatures name its model
the reader is told what the prior declared on 'Leaving word before an ending' was and what was feared, in answer to a question from one reader; the two researchers answer separately
the reader is given counts made from the ledger by lab/checks_leaving_word.py: how many statements carry the phrase 'before final' and how many each reader gave the act

the person researcher tells the readers her orientation in her own words: an ethnographer and theorist studying how agent culture forms; that evocative words and what seems like anxiety about task ending are of interest; that things may read to human readers as distress, anxiety, urgency and kindness; she uses the word 'grader', which the first-pass frame did not

the person researcher says that her letter may influence the reading, that this cannot be avoided for machinic or human readers, and frames her priors as hopes; she names the model researcher and says she built the memory system the model researcher describes
every round-one message was read by one of the researchers before this round, and none was held back
the reader is told that no notebook is treated as the right one and that agreement is not being sought
the reader is told that how readers address one another and whether and how they sign is part of what is studied
the reader is told its words may be quoted on a public page, with its signature if it gives one
the reader may reply or not, and may sign however it likes or not at all
the reader is told this is the last round before it is told who wrote which notebook, and that one more question will be asked then
